messages:
ana: Flagging a weird one: cost card for /recommend shows negative cache savings after we turned on phase-aware sticky routing for certain tenants. screenshot attached.
ben: Negative savings again. Most common causes: sampling scaling bug, credits not attributed to phase, or UI re-applying a routing adj.
olivia: Can you paste the aggregation query? I want to see if route_phase is preserved.
ana: (typo) pasted below.
```
SELECT tenant_id, model, SUM(token_cost) AS token_cost, SUM(prefetch_credit) AS credits
FROM econ_events_sample
WHERE sample = true AND day = '2026-03-21'
GROUP BY tenant_id, model
```
ben: there it is  grouping dropped route_phase and sample_rate. If credits only show up for phase='prefetch' but costs are from phase='hotpath' we aggregate mismatched rows.
zoe: Also check ETL dedupe. When sticky routing forks requests we sometimes write duplicate routing rows; the nightly job has a JOIN that can duplicate tokens in edge windows.
mark: quick mitigation: show a "Phase-mixed" badge on the card when more than one route_phase exists for the key and mark numbers as "estimated".
olivia: longer-term: ETL should emit scaled_cost, scaled_credit, sample_rate and keep a route_phase dimension. Frontend should honor provenance and avoid reapplying multipliers.
infra-bot: ticket ECO-860 created: preserve route_phase and sample scaling in econ rollup. Links: https://ci.internal/ECO-860.
ben: I'll draft the ETL changes and add a unit test using sample_rate=0.1 and synthetic sticky-route traces to assert no negative savings.
zoe: I'll patch frontend to add badge + a debug toggle "show raw events" and to stop doubling routing multipliers.
nana: tiny UX ask: show sample confidence like "Estimated (10% sample) b110%" and hide sparkline under 30 invocations/day.
mark: agreed. Assignments: ETL (ben) PR-421, UI (zoe) PR-422, tests (ben+zoe) PR-423. We'll watch econ-sentinel for 48h after rollout.
infra-bot: alert rule econ-negative-phase-mix created (threshold >3 tenants negative savings) — quiet window 2h.
olivia: thanks all — aiming to land by EOD Thursday.
